title: Number 1
textBlocks:
God gave Moses the 10 commandments
TEN RULES
to keep us safe

RULE NUMBER 1: 
Is that we must only worship God

The Israelites kept getting into trouble because they would forget about God.
And disobey Him and worship other gods.

We must follow God’s rules.

Activity Time - Make some rock art
Find some stones in your garden and make feet. Feet remind us to follow Jesus. And to walk with Jesus.
Ask your mom to draw or download, print, decorate and cut out

Talk to Jesus
Dear Lord
Thank you for today
Thank you for my mom and dad
Thank you for Your rules to keep me safe
I want to follow You
Amen
